title: Uniform C^∞ approximation of a continuous compactly supported covector field inside its support, keeping |·|_E ≤ 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and f : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n continuous with compact support and |f(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z (|·|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm). Then for every κ > 0 there is a differential n-form h : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n with IsTestForm h (C^∞ with compact support), support h ⊆ support f (Function.support, i.e. h(z) = 0 wherever f(z) = 0), |h(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z, and |h(z) − f(z)|_E ≤ κ for all z.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (f z) ≤ 1) → ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → ∃ h : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm h ∧ support h ⊆ support f ∧ (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (h z) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (h z - f z) ≤ κ
